I am the son of Afghan refugee parents who came to the United States seeking safety, dignity, and opportunity. My commitment to public service is rooted in the idea that government should work for everyone. As a Trustee on the Chabot-Las Positas Community College Board, I am committed to championing student success, workforce pathways, and equitable access to higher education. This November, as I seek re-election, I would be honored to have your support and vote once again. — Harris
